In summary, Cognito highly aligns with the literature offering students a highly 
self-regulated experience, they reduce extraneous load by providing videos for 
each lesson. The site supports a wide range of revision methods such as flash 
cards, and actionable analytics to support revision. 
2.5.4 Save My Exams 
Save my exams follows a relatively simple structure, where the site is divided 
into two parts (1) revision notes, which are essentially written lessons with the 
odd video, (2) questions, that the student must mark themselves. The student 
has the option to select the difficulty of the questions improving self-regulated 
learning. However, questions are not asked during or after the revision notes, 
requiring the student to go to a completely separate part of the site, breaking 
user flow and may disincentivize students from completing questions.  
The site does not follow recommendations from the literature, with poor user 
flow and no useful analytics, the extraneous load on students is likely to be high. 
Despite this online reviews are very good scoring 4.8 stars on (Trustpilot, 2024), 
with most people claiming to be highly satisfied with the content delivered.
